note: What a client sends once it has loaded and is ready to play. It comes unprompted, before any start of play reaches the client. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: moduleOne
fields.note: One of three values a client reports about software it has detected alongside itself. Observed as zero.

fields.name: tipChosen
fields.note: Which tip the client is set to show.

bits.name: tips
bits.note: Set while tips are wanted at all.

bits.name: reporting
bits.note: Set while the client reports on itself.

bits.name: loadingTips
bits.note: Set while tips are wanted while loading.

bits.name: playingTips
bits.note: Set while tips are wanted during play.

bits.name: debug
bits.note: Set while the client runs in a debugging state.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Returned as the server sent them; a client does not read them.

fields.name: moduleTwo
fields.note: The second of the three. Observed as zero.

revisions.note: The tip fields return the tip bytes of VersionSync as the client has corrected them: a figure it found invalid is negated (0 becomes -128) and tips cleared. Playing a replay, a client sends all four as zero. The three module fields are always zero.
